metric_metadata.legacy_quality_psnr: float32 Torch mean retained separately; H main PSNR remains original float64 mean

metric_evaluator.backbone_relationships: Communication encoder/VAR/Dc are separate from these evaluation backbones. DreamSim includes DINO and CLIP families; evaluation metrics are not mutually independent. D_C classification is label-conditioned and descriptive only.
metric_evaluator.existing_dino: Retain registered dino_cosine=DINOv2 ViT-S/14 unchanged; dinov2_vitl14_cosine is a separate added column
metric_evaluator.input: RGB BCHW float32 [0,1]; no additional 8-bit quantization
metric_evaluator.metric_selection_usage: evaluation only; never policy selection or model training

preprocessing.tensor_vs_PIL: same geometry/constants, floating tensor interpolation; no claim of bitwise PIL equivalence

dinov2_vitl14.model_id: Meta DINOv2 ViT-L/14 standard LVD-142M backbone, no registers, 1024-d x_norm_clstoken cosine

dists.model_id: DISTS official learned alpha/beta; torchvision VGG16 IMAGENET1K_V1

preprocessing.normalization: official per-backbone internal normalization and normalize_embeds=True

ms_ssim.model_id: VainF/pytorch-msssim MS-SSIM, RGB, data_range=1, five scales

reference_cache_prior_audit: No persisted old source feature cache; first preparation is explicitly new
